The '''Pyroclast''' was a model of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] produced by [[Praxon]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />
{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Praxon Pyroclast was a player mount in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" /> It was added to the game in Game Update 2.4 as a rare reward obtainable during the [[Dread Fortress]] operation.<ref name="2.4">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/2.4.0/dread-war|text=Game Update 2.4: The Dread War Patch Notes}}</ref>
